section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) examining associations between Big Five personality traits and men's body image. The study involved 509 men from the community in London, UK, who completed measures of drive for muscularity, body appreciation, Big Five personality domains, and subjective social status. Results from hierarchical regression analysis showed that Neuroticism and Extraversion significantly predicted body appreciation when controlling for BMI and subjective social status.
